name: claude-code
summary: Adds the entry block to CLAUDE.md for projects whose CLAUDE.md does not already import AGENTS.md.
tested: Claude Code sessions worked in a pilot project that had the block in both CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, releases 0.1.0 and 0.1.1, October 2026; which file they read first was not recorded.
manual: Paste templates/entry-block.md into CLAUDE.md, or import AGENTS.md from it and use agents-md instead.
